verdicts.reason: Both break up the original: the full-height colour stripes shrink to three small decorative bars and the white card is lost. 'for all drinkware on', which explains the price, drops to an unreadable speck. In both, the vertical URL floats in the middle of large dead white gaps. A also has a smallish price and a small, cramped product list in the far-right corner, with the caption shrunk to illegible size at the bottom. B gives the price and the list more presence and fills the height better, but its caption is even smaller (invisible) and the list is jammed against the right edge, so B is only the less bad of the two.
